title: User working rules: reply in Spanish, commit by topic, push only when asked
what:
How the user wants agents to work in this repository:
- Reply to the user in Spanish (español); code, commit messages, README and identifiers stay in English.
- Commit by topic in the conventional format (feat/fix/test/ci/style/chore(harness)), with no AI attribution or co-author lines.
- Commit or push only when the user asks.
- Never bypass git hooks (--no-verify is blocked).
- Destructive git operations (drop a stash, mass checkout, reset) need the user's explicit OK.
- In orchestrator mode the main thread never edits code; only the user turns the mode off.
- Anvil's goal is code quality with minimal or no slop; token and time savings are secondary.
why: The user restated these rules several times while working with Claude Code; every agent (Claude Code, Antigravity) should follow them from the first message.
learned: Language: Spanish for the user, English for the repo. Push and commit only on request. Never use --no-verify.
author: reactive-end
